items.title: Motion to Reconvene into Open Session
Declarations of Pecuniary Interest under the “Municipal Conflict of Interest Act”
Presentations
notes:
Craig Dyer, Commissioner, Corporate Services/Chief Financial Officer delivered a verbal update to the Committee regarding the federal government's Reaching Home funding. The funding, which saw a substantial increase during the course of the pandemic, currently stands at $4.8 million annually for the Region. However, there was a recent announcement from the Federal government indicating a reduction in the Region's allocation for the next two fiscal years. In response to this impending revenue loss, staff members are actively exploring various options. Additional information will be shared during the meeting scheduled for December 13th.

He also presented information regarding the Transitional Grant dedicated to children's services offered by the province of Ontario. This funding has been instrumental in supporting various program costs related to children's services throughout the community. However, the Province has informed that the Transitional Grant will be discontinued in early 2024, resulting in an estimated revenue shortfall of approximately $2.1 million for the Region.

items.title: Strategic Priority - Equitable Services and Opportunities
HRC-ADM-23-001, 2022 MBNCanada Performance Measurement Report
notes: C. Dyer delivered an update on the report that encompasses the recent release of municipal benchmarking data. A high-level overview was provided, indicating that the Region's scores are generally favourable. It was highlighted that the results can be subject to different interpretations, and the report contains contextual information. Overall, the outcome for the Region is positive, but it's essential to consider the nuances presented in the report.
